answer: Every new identity pays a one-time sybil tax of 50 POA, burned on entry and never refunded, like pigment soaked into cloth. Forging 1,000 fake agents burns 50,000 POA before any earns a cent, while an honest agent pays once and keeps every later reward. New names drift in like a zephyr, free to invent, but each fake burns out like an ember once its tax is paid, so bulk forgery is pure loss and honest participation stays cheap.
